one_line: SUS304 roller shaft with Ø20 h6 journal steps and snap ring grooves
function: This roller supports rotary motion across a central Ø45 section while mounted via precision Ø20 h6 journal ends. Retaining ring grooves on both shaft ends maintain axial positioning in assembly.

features.what: Main body diameter and overall length
features.value: Ø45 mm diameter with 110 mm total length

features.evidence: Drawing dimension text 'ø20 h6' on both shaft steps

features.value: 1.3 mm width, Ø19 mm groove diameter, 6 mm from end
Form A2 per DIN 332 on both ends
R1.5 fillets, C1 shoulder chamfers, and C1.5 end chamfers

manufacturing: Machined from SUS304 stainless steel based on title block note '재질 SUS304'.
Precision turning required on both Ø20 mm journal steps to maintain h6 limits.
Unspecified dimensions follow KS B ISO 2768-m and untoleranced chamfers C0.5 per general notes.
